description: The newest published press releases, optionally within one desk or one category. Use it for 'what is new in tech', 'latest funding announcements', 'recent releases on CourierPR'. Each result is a title, company, date, short summary and a link; the full text is on the linked page. Limitation: at most 10 per call, newest first, no date filter.

category.description: Category slug or name from list_desks, e.g. business-finance. Takes precedence over desk.

desk.description: Desk slug or name from list_desks, e.g. science-tech

name: latest_releases
title: Newest press releases
